---
title: "Monthly sales report"
subtitle: "Online Retail II | ANALIT802 Lab 09"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
params:
  month: "2011-11"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Read the pipeline's results. tar_read() makes each target a dependency of
# this report, so the report re-renders when any of them changes.
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)

# The pipeline's data store, found from the project root, so this also works
# when the chunks are run from reports/ (Render button, Run All)
store <- here::here("_targets")
if (!dir.exists(store)) {
  stop("No pipeline results yet: run targets::tar_make() in the project folder first.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
kpis <- tar_read(kpis, store = store)
top_products <- tar_read(top_products, store = store)
top_countries <- tar_read(top_countries, store = store)

# Guard: the figures must be for the month this report is labelled with
stopifnot(kpis$month == params$month)

# Format money with a pound sign and thousands separators
gbp <- function(x) paste0("£", format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE))
```

## Sales in `r params$month`

Completed product sales came to `r gbp(kpis$revenue)` from
`r format(kpis$orders, big.mark = ",")` orders placed by
`r format(kpis$customers, big.mark = ",")` identified customers.
The average order was worth `r gbp(kpis$avg_order_value)`.

### Top five products by revenue

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Top products for the month, revenue rounded to whole pounds
top_products |>
  mutate(revenue = gbp(revenue)) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Product", "Revenue"))
```

### Top five countries by revenue

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Top countries for the month
top_countries |>
  mutate(revenue = gbp(revenue)) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Country", "Revenue"))
```

Source: monthly extract of the UCI Online Retail II dataset. Completed sales
exclude cancellations, stock adjustments and non-product codes.
